cases.sentence: Иисус шел впереди встревоженных учеников, а за ними следовал испуганный ___.
cases.translation: Jesus walked ahead of the troubled disciples, and a frightened crowd followed behind them.
cases.explain: Народ is the subject of следовал (followed), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: У ___ сидел слепой нищий Вартимей, то есть сын Тимея.
cases.translation: A blind beggar Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the road.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by/at) takes the genitive → дороги.

cases.sentence: Некоторые люди приносили к ___ детей, чтобы Он прикоснулся к ним и благословил.
cases.translation: Some people were bringing children to Jesus so that he would touch and bless them.
cases.explain: К (to/towards) always takes the dative → Иисусу.
Нищего is the direct object of исцеляет (heals); animate masculine nouns take a genitive-like accusative ending.

cases.sentence: Каждый, кто разводится со своей ___ и женится на другой, нарушает супружескую верность.
cases.translation: Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery.
cases.explain: Со (=с, with) takes the instrumental → женой.

cases.sentence: Однако многие из тех, кто в этом ___ был возвышен, будут унижены.
cases.translation: But many who were exalted in this world will be humbled.
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location takes the prepositional → мире.

reading.ru: К нему подошли фарисеи, и чтобы поймать его на слове, спросили, «Разрешено ли мужу разводиться с женой?»
reading.question: What test question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?
options: Whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife
Whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar
Whether the Sabbath may be broken
reading.correct: Whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife
reading.explain: The Pharisees asked whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife, trying to trap Jesus.

reading.ru: Итак, что Бог соединил, то человек не должен разделять.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about what God has joined together?
options: No one should separate what God has joined together
It should be separated after seven years
It can be separated by mutual consent
reading.correct: No one should separate what God has joined together
reading.explain: Jesus concludes that what God has joined together, man must not separate.

reading.ru: Некоторые люди приносили к Иисусу детей, чтобы Он прикоснулся к ним и благословил.
reading.question: Why were people bringing children to Jesus?
options: So that he would touch and bless them
So that he would heal their illnesses
So that he would teach them to read
So that he would baptize them
reading.correct: So that he would touch and bless them
reading.explain: People brought children so that Jesus would touch and bless them.

reading.ru: Говорю вам истину, кто не примет Божье Царство как ребенок, тот не войдет в него.
reading.question: How does Jesus say one must receive God's Kingdom?
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever does not receive God's Kingdom like a child will not enter it.

reading.ru: «Благой учитель, что мне делать, чтобы наследовать вечную жизнь?»
reading.question: What did the rich man ask Jesus?
options: What must I do to inherit eternal life
How can I become the richest man in Israel
Who is greater in the Kingdom of God
When will the Kingdom of God come
reading.correct: What must I do to inherit eternal life
reading.explain: The man asked Jesus what he must do to inherit eternal life.

reading.ru: Пойди, продай все, что у тебя есть, и раздай деньги бедным, и тогда у тебя будет сокровище на небесах.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the rich man to do?
options: Sell everything and give the money to the poor
Give up his position of authority
reading.correct: Sell everything and give the money to the poor
reading.explain: Jesus told the man to sell all he had, give it to the poor, and follow him.

reading.ru: «Легче верблюду пройти сквозь игольное ушко, чем богатому войти в Божье Царство».
reading.question: What comparison does Jesus use to describe how hard it is for the rich to enter God's Kingdom?
options: A camel going through a needle's eye
A lamb entering a lion's den
A tree growing in the desert
reading.correct: A camel going through a needle's eye
reading.explain: Jesus says it is easier for a camel to pass through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter God's Kingdom.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «Говорю вам истину, каждый, кто оставил дом, или братьев, или сестер, или мать, или отца, или детей, или земли ради Меня и ради радостной вести, получит в этой жизни в сто раз больше и домов, и братьев, и сестер, и матерей, и детей, и земель, но также и преследований».
reading.question: What did Jesus promise those who left everything for him and the gospel?
options: A hundred times as much in this life, along with persecutions
reading.correct: A hundred times as much in this life, along with persecutions
reading.explain: Jesus promised a hundredfold return in this life, along with persecutions, and eternal life in the age to come.

reading.ru: «Вот мы восходим в Иерусалим, там сына человеческого выдадут первосвященникам и учителям закона».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict would happen to him in Jerusalem?
options: He would be handed over to the chief priests and teachers of the law
He would be welcomed by the Pharisees
He would build a new temple
reading.correct: He would be handed over to the chief priests and teachers of the law
reading.explain: Jesus foretold that the Son of Man would be handed over to the chief priests and teachers of the law.

reading.ru: «Позволь нам в твоей славе сесть одному по правую, а другому по левую руку от тебя», — сказали они.
reading.question: What did James and John ask Jesus for?
options: To sit at his right and left hand in his glory
To be given the largest house in Jerusalem
reading.correct: To sit at his right and left hand in his glory
reading.explain: James and John asked to sit at Jesus's right and left hand in his glory.

reading.ru: Ведь и Сын Человеческий пришел не для того, чтобы Ему служили, но чтобы служить другим и отдать свою жизнь, как выкуп за многих.
reading.question: Why did the Son of Man come, according to Jesus?
options: To serve others and give his life as a ransom for many
To be served by kings and rulers
reading.correct: To serve others and give his life as a ransom for many
reading.explain: Jesus says the Son of Man came to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

reading.ru: Услышав, что мимо проходит Иисус из Назарета, он стал кричать, «Иисус, сын Давида, сжалься надо мной!»
reading.question: What did the blind beggar Bartimaeus cry out when he heard Jesus was passing by?
options: "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me"
reading.correct: "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me"
reading.explain: Bartimaeus cried out, "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!"

reading.ru: Слепой сразу же обрел зрение и пошел по дороге за Иисусом.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Jesus healed Bartimaeus?
options: He received his sight and followed Jesus on the road
He returned home to his family
He went to the temple to give thanks
He became one of the twelve apostles
reading.correct: He received his sight and followed Jesus on the road
reading.explain: Bartimaeus immediately received his sight and followed Jesus on the road.
